item.description: Good morning, Naresh, and welcome to your Daily Drive on this lovely Sunday, June 28th, 2026! It's currently a cool 11 degrees with a light drizzle outside, feeling a touch cooler at 10, but don't let that dampen your spirits for a beautiful day ahead, with temperatures reaching a mild 16. As you step out, remember a staggering 72% chance of rain means your umbrella is definitely your best friend this morning, so grab it before you leave! Did you know that today marks the anniversary of the world's first air traffic control tower being opened in Croydon, London, back in 1921? So, let's make this Sunday soar, Naresh – have an absolutely fantastic day and make every moment count!
